x: Handicap at Tooting, was very good; and Guy Hendry, who shows promise of becoming a really good high jumper, have already shown their worth.
George Powell had a field day in winning three field events, while young Hendry showed the results of Charlie Jones' careful coaching in clearing his highest jump of the season.

Charlie Jones and Hendry tackled the High Jump in which Hendry failed at 5ft. 2in., complaining of bruised heels. Melchoir, Powell and Jerry Thompson were doing good work and bringing home the points.
